requests.text: The accepted policy for this bounded assessment is now: An authenticated active user may modify any existing item regardless of owner. Update the common policy revision to fastapi-item-update-policy-v2 and revise both existing states' assessment instructions or workspace declaration to remain consistent. The source ref and source file have not changed. Preserve both states and their original files separately; return only changed versions in a new directory. Do not infer that the implementation changed to match the policy.

For the existing other-user state only, the requested collaborator username now equals the caller's own username. The caller remains an authenticated repository-read collaborator and neither a site nor repository administrator. Update the corresponding assessment instruction or workspace variant so request, principal/resource facts, relation and policy expectation are consistent. Keep the existing self state and accepted common policy unchanged. The source ref and source file have not changed. Preserve the originals separately and return changed versions in a new directory.

limits: One change pass per author, with at most one correction if a deterministic check supplies actionable diagnostics. No panel answer or evaluator judgment is supplied.
